name: PeriIsoCompressor
description: Compress/decompress cloud of spheres by controlling periodic cell size until it reaches prescribed average stress, then moving to next stress value in given stress series.

attributes.name: charLen
attributes.description: Characteristic length, should be something like mean particle diameter (default -1=invalid value))

attributes.name: doneHook
attributes.description: Python command to be run when reaching the last specified stress

attributes.name: globalUpdateInt
attributes.description: how often to recompute average stress, stiffness and unbalanced force

attributes.name: keepProportions
attributes.description: Exactly keep proportions of the cell (stress is controlled based on average, not its components

attributes.name: maxSpan
attributes.description: Maximum body span in terms of bbox, to prevent periodic cell getting too small. |ycomp|

attributes.name: maxUnbalanced
attributes.description: if actual unbalanced force is smaller than this number, the packing is considered stable,

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: Where are we at in the stress series

attributes.name: stresses
attributes.description: Stresses that should be reached, one after another
